All 193 tests pass (20 backend_test.py + 173 pytest including 24 new strategy v2 tests). Updated 4 test expectations to match new config values.

RSI removed: _long_ready conditions don't check RSI
RSI removed: _short_ready conditions don't check RSI
Structure detection returns all scenarios (breakout/pullback/continuation for long/short)
Breakout long detection requires trend alignment and structure break
Continuation detection checks momentum (closing price direction)
AI system prompt focuses on momentum continuation, not RSI reversal
AI fake breakout veto keywords present (fake breakout, bull trap, bear trap)
AI min_confidence lowered to 55 for v2 (more permissive)
AI fail_open enabled (allows trades when AI fails)
Entry engine uses liq_stop_buffer_atr=0.35 for protective SL
Entry engine uses level_tp_buffer_atr=0.20 for TP buffer
Manual position derives levels from liquidity clusters and swing levels
SCAN SUMMARY log format present with rejection counters
Reject reason tracking implemented (mark_reject pattern)
Config v2: transformer_threshold=0.56 (permissive)
Config v2: max_liq_distance_pct=1.10 (farther targets allowed)
Config v2: min_orderflow_imbalance=1.05 (achievable)
Config v2: min_rr_ratio=1.4 (reasonable)
Config v2: allowed_regimes includes 'chop'

No regression: basket_profit_guard enabled (min 2 positions)

critical_code_review_comments: Strategy v2 correctly removes RSI from entry conditions - no RSI threshold/overbought/oversold checks in EntryEngine
_detect_structure() returns 6 structure types: breakout_long/short, pullback_long/short, continuation_long/short
Structure triggers are trend-aligned: breakout requires price >= breakout_high * 0.998, pullback requires touch of EMA then bounce
AI veto is now soft: only explicit fake-breakout keywords (fake breakout, bull trap, bear trap) with confidence >= 70 trigger hard veto
structural_override bypasses AI veto when: confidence >= 0.72 AND trend == htf_trend AND (structure_breakout OR structure_pullback)
_derive_manual_position_levels() uses liquidity clusters and swing highs/lows for level-based SL/TP, falls back to ATR*min_rr_ratio
SCAN SUMMARY logs rejection counters via mark_reject() pattern in _scan_entries()
Config changes: transformer_threshold 0.60->0.56, max_liq_distance 0.55->1.10, orderflow_imbalance 1.12->1.05, min_rr 1.8->1.4
allowed_regimes now includes 'chop' for more entry opportunities
seed_data_creation: None - all tests use mocked/synthetic data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strategy v2 implementation verified: (1) RSI is completely removed from entry conditions, (2) AI veto is advisory-only except for explicit fake-breakout keywords, (3) Entry uses breakout+pullback+continuation structure detection, (4) SL/TP derivation uses liquidity clusters and swing levels with ATR buffers, (5) Config thresholds lowered to address no-trade problem. No live network testing performed per instructions.
rca_of_the_issue: Strategy v2 addresses the no-trade problem: Previous strategy was too restrictive with RSI acting as hard reversal gate, high transformer_threshold (0.60), tight max_liq_distance (0.55), and strict orderflow imbalance (1.12). The rewrite removes RSI entirely, lowers thresholds (0.56, 1.10, 1.05), and makes AI veto soft (advisory-only except for fake-breakout). SL/TP now derives from structural levels (liquidity clusters, swing highs/lows) instead of blind ATR-based calculations.
